decision_rules.authority: User authorized one next bounded study on2026-10-06; no successor.
decision_rules.budget_boundary: Two4376-update/280064-slot tasks, zero extra pretraining, oneH100NVL each,8CPU/64GiB/36h, no requeue. Same architecture, not guaranteed equal realized compute.
decision_rules.confirmation: Require reproducible joint exact/inclusive efficiency improvement with paired category-stratified collision uncertainty and no continuum fake-B degradation; zero successes or only shallow proxy gains do not establish efficiency benefit. Preserve every original diagnostic gate.
decision_rules.dataset_size: Hold70000; no controlled size effect or comparative superiority of pretraining is established.
decision_rules.execution_check: Both arms keep the enabled relation-bias architecture, mixed exposure and identical initialization. Verify saved auxiliary objective weights0.5/1.0, positive native auxiliary losses, target counts and actual model forwards.
decision_rules.historical_basis: End the decoder-bias ablation family: exact B tagging is0/8000 in both arms, and one inclusive disabled-arm success has a paired interval including zero. Disabling bias raises exact nontrivial components315/18445 to522/18445 but lowers retained LCAG3559/729425 to3306/729425 and nontrivial source recall, while pooled continuum fake-B event acceptance rises499/8000 to608/8000. This is not a joint efficiency winner. Both models lose approximately25% of repeated targets as legally unrepresentable in generated contexts, despite usable fixed-input geometry. Test auxiliary complete-target teacher loss weight0.5 versus1.0 while retaining the same mixed-context regime and enabled-bias reference architecture. This is a bounded task-objective hypothesis, not a claim that stronger anchoring is already useful: Phase37 tested0.25/0.5 with weak hierarchy evidence, and Phase66/67 teacher-only improved target preservation without joint reconstruction benefit. Neither historical holds nor these comparisons identify superiority of pretraining improvement over training-data scaling. Hold70000 for this one controlled study; no extra pretraining or automatic dose sweep.
decision_rules.primary: Exact retained and inclusive FSP-group per-B correct-tag efficiency; any-B, both-B and coherent pair; all full/half category-sized endpoints.
decision_rules.stop_rule: Review this single bounded objective pair once. No dose sweep, automatic successor, sealed test or model promotion.
decision_rules.uncertainty: Paired category-stratified collision intervals; report sparse-success bounds, unavailable truth and training-seed limitations. No cross-cohort pooling.

efficiency_effect_target.interpretation: At least four additional proven B successes per8000 nominal trials is a predeclared useful effect target, not a power guarantee; require positive paired lower confidence bounds on full exact/inclusive gains and no point deterioration in pooled fake-B background. Report all half/category endpoints, intervals and sparse bounds; no substitute proxy winner.
